gazette_location.description_raw_en: Cul-de-sac commencing at its junction with Tung Tau Wan Road, running in a northerly direction and then turning north-west for a total distance of approximately 60 m., as shown coloured pink on drawing No. HH 3339.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此路徑為盡頭路，起點與東頭灣道會合，向北伸展，然後轉向西北，全長約六十公尺，其位置在 HH 3339 號圖則上用粉紅色標明。
